tradeFlow.tooltipMode: Choose the visualization style for real-time trades. Each mode represents buy and sell orders differently — experiment to find the one that fits your workflow.
tradeFlow.tooltipVolumeScale: Amplifies or dampens how strongly the scene reacts to each trade's volume. 1.0 = neutral; below calms things down, above emphasises large orders up to 5×.
tradeFlow.tooltipTimeWindow: How long past trades remain visible before fading out. Longer windows show more historical context but may feel cluttered.
tradeFlow.tooltipMinVolume: Filters out trades below this dollar value. Use this to focus on whale-sized orders only. Warning: high values on smaller pairs may hide all trades.
tradeFlow.tooltipDynamicAtmosphere: The scene reads two market signals: mood (rolling buy/sell ratio or RSI) and activity (trade rate, volume, volatility/ATR). Mood tints the background, lights and sky green (bullish) or red (bearish); activity brightens them and thickens the fog and nebula. A calm market stays dark and still, a busy one comes alive. Turning it off returns the scene to a neutral, quiet state.
tradeFlow.tooltipAtmosphereIntensity: How strongly the atmosphere reacts on top of the on/off switch: scales the colour tint, light boost, fog density and nebula opacity. 0 leaves the scene visually neutral, 1 is the tuned default, up to 2 exaggerates it.
tradeFlow.tooltipAtmosphereSpeed: How quickly the scene follows the market. Scales the smoothing time constants and the nebula drift: higher reacts faster, lower drifts slowly. Does not change the resting look.
tradeFlow.tooltipGridWidth: Number of points along the X-axis of the visualization grid. More points = finer detail but higher GPU load.
tradeFlow.tooltipGridLength: Number of points along the Z-axis of the visualization grid. More points = finer detail but higher GPU load.
tradeFlow.tooltipSpeed: Sonar pace: how fast the sweep travels across the scene. Below 1 slows it down, up to 5 speeds it up. Only affects Sonar mode.
tradeFlow.tooltipRotation: Slow, purely decorative spin of the scene. Off by default: rotation makes the time (depth) and price (height) axes unreadable.
tradeFlow.tooltipSource: Keeps the background alive when the live feed goes quiet. 'Live' shows only real trades. 'Ambient' injects subtle synthetic ticks after a pause. 'Replay' continuously replays the most recent trades as synthetic ticks.
tradeFlow.tooltipBlock: Each block = one trade. Height = price, depth = age (front = now), size = volume (notional). Green = buy, red = sell. Fibonacci planes + price spine are fixed price references. Rotation (opt-in) spins the whole scene — off by default so axes stay readable.
tradeFlow.tooltipGalaxy: A copy of the Galaxy 3D background, wired to the live trade feed. Every trade sends a shockwave outward from the core — buys lift the stars and tint them with the buy colour, sells press them down. Wave size follows trade volume. This galaxy is tuned independently of the standalone Galaxy 3D background.
tradeFlow.tooltipMarketReactivity: How strongly a single trade deforms the galaxy. 0 turns the trade shockwaves off entirely and leaves a purely decorative galaxy.
tradeFlow.tooltipSentimentTint: How far the star colours drift toward the buy or sell colour as the rolling buy/sell ratio moves. 0 keeps the theme's own galaxy palette at all times.
tradeFlow.tooltipActivityRotation: How much market heat (trade rate, notional volume and price volatility) speeds up the galaxy's rotation. 0 keeps the rotation constant.
tradeFlow.tooltipPriceAxis: Turns the disc's radius into a price scale: a trade's shockwave starts where that trade sits in the recent price range — near the core at the bottom of the range, near the rim at the top — and buys sweep outward while sells sweep inward. Off: every wave starts at the core and radius carries no meaning.
tradeFlow.tooltipIndicators: Trades are events; ATR and RSI are states. These two feed the scene's amplitude and its colour mood instead of individual trades. Both fall back to the trade-derived signal whenever no indicator value is available, so the background never goes flat.
tradeFlow.tooltipVolatilitySource: Drives fog density, light intensity, nebula and galaxy spin. 'ATR' uses the real Average True Range divided by price, so a calm market genuinely looks calm rather than merely trade-poor. 'Trade spread' uses the price scatter of the last ~100 prints — always available, but a cruder stand-in.
tradeFlow.tooltipMoodSource: Drives the buy/sell tint of lighting, fog and galaxy arms. 'Trade sentiment' is the buy/sell ratio of the last 100 trades — a view of the last few seconds. 'RSI' is the same question over the chosen candle interval: overbought tints toward the buy colour, oversold toward the sell colour.
tradeFlow.tooltipIndicatorTimeframe: Shared with the Technicals panel: editable in both places, always applies to both. The background's ATR and RSI are read from this interval — if a chart is already open on it, the values cost nothing extra.
tradeFlow.tooltipAtrBands: Draws three rings on the price axis: the last traded price, and ±1 ATR around it. Lets you see at a glance whether a trade's shockwave sits inside the market's normal range or is breaking out of it. Needs the radial price axis and an available ATR reading; with the 2× ATR axis span, ±1 ATR rings sit near the 1/4 and 3/4 points, moving only if price wanders 1+ ATR from the recent centre — which is itself the answer.
tradeFlow.tooltipAtrBandWidth: How many ATRs the outer rings sit from the last price. 1.00 = the classic ±1 ATR band; smaller tightens the rings toward the price, larger spreads them out. Beyond ±2 ATR (the axis span) they pin to the disc rim, which reads as "price is far from its recent centre".
tradeFlow.tooltipAtrBandStrength: Opacity of the reference rings. 1.0 = the tuned default; 0 hides them without turning the feature off; higher makes them brighter.

headAndShoulders.name: H&S (Head and Shoulders)
headAndShoulders.description: An H&S pattern is a bearish reversal formation that typically occurs at the end of an uptrend. It consists of three highs, with the middle high (head) higher than the two outer highs (shoulders). A neckline connects the lows between the highs.
characteristics: Three peaks: left shoulder, head (highest peak), right shoulder.
Neckline connects the lows between the peaks.
Volume is often higher on the left shoulder and the head, lower on the right shoulder.
headAndShoulders.trading:
A sell signal is generated when price breaks down through the neckline. The price target is often calculated as the distance from the head to the neckline, projected down from the breakout point.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high, especially with a clean neckline break on elevated volume followed by confirmation (e.g. pullback to the neckline, which then holds as resistance).
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position at or after the neckline break. Stop-loss (SL): just above the neckline or above the right shoulder. Take-profit (TP): at least the head-to-neckline distance, projected down from the breakout point.
headAndShoulders.advancedConsiderations:
Failed breakouts: A failed upside breakout through the neckline can be a strong bullish signal (see H&S top failure). A downside break that quickly closes back above the neckline can also be a trap.
Variations: The neckline can slope slightly. The shoulders do not need to be exactly equal in height.
Context: Stronger signal after a longer, established uptrend. Bearish divergences in RSI or MACD can reinforce the signal.
Combinations: Can be part of a larger topping formation or follow the failed breakout of another pattern.
headAndShoulders.performanceStats: Historically one of the more reliable reversal formations. Win rate varies by market and timeframe but is often above 60-70% with textbook structure and confirmation. The risk-reward ratio is often favorable since the price target is clearly defined.

inverseHeadAndShoulders.name: Inverse H&S (iH&S)
inverseHeadAndShoulders.description: An inverse H&S formation is a bullish reversal pattern that typically occurs at the end of a downtrend. It is the mirror image of the H&S pattern.
characteristics: Three lows: left shoulder, head (deepest point), right shoulder.
Neckline connects the highs between the lows.
Volume can expand on the breakout above the neckline.
inverseHeadAndShoulders.trading:
A buy signal is generated when price breaks up through the neckline. The price target is often calculated as the distance from the head to the neckline, projected up from the breakout point.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high, especially with a clean neckline break on elevated volume followed by confirmation (e.g. pullback to the neckline, which then holds as support).
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position at or after the neckline break. SL: just below the neckline or below the right shoulder. TP: at least the head-to-neckline distance, projected up from the breakout point.
inverseHeadAndShoulders.advancedConsiderations:
Failed breakouts: A failed downside breakout through the neckline can be a strong bearish signal (see inverse H&S bottom failure).
Variations: The neckline can slope slightly. The shoulders do not need to be exactly equal in depth.
Context: Stronger signal after a longer, established downtrend. Bullish divergences in RSI or MACD can reinforce the signal.
inverseHeadAndShoulders.performanceStats: Similarly reliable as the H&S top. Win rate is comparable, and the risk-reward ratio can be attractive.

headAndShouldersTopFailure.name: H&S Top Failure
headAndShouldersTopFailure.description: An H&S top failure occurs when an H&S pattern starts to form but price fails to break down through the neckline sustainably, instead rising back above the right shoulder or even the head. This can be a strong bullish signal.
characteristics: Developing H&S top structure (left shoulder, head, right shoulder).
Price fails to break down through the neckline significantly.
Instead price rises again, often above the level of the right shoulder or the head.
Signals that sellers were not strong enough to reverse the trend.
headAndShouldersTopFailure.trading:
A buy signal emerges when price regains strength after the failed neckline break and rises above key resistance levels of the unfinished H&S pattern.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high, as the failed breakout often traps short sellers and can trigger a strong countermove.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position when price rises above the right shoulder or the head of the failed H&S pattern. SL: below the neckline or the low of the right shoulder. TP: based on prior resistance levels or Fibonacci projections of the preceding uptrend.
headAndShouldersTopFailure.advancedConsiderations: Watch the volume: a failed break with low volume on the neckline-break attempt, followed by a higher-volume advance, is a stronger signal.
headAndShouldersTopFailure.performanceStats: Failed breakouts can be strong signals since they catch market participants on the wrong foot. Reliability depends on the strength of the reversal.

headAndShouldersBottomFailure.name: Inverse H&S Bottom Failure
headAndShouldersBottomFailure.description: An inverse H&S bottom failure occurs when an inverse H&S pattern starts to form but price fails to break up through the neckline sustainably, instead falling back below the right shoulder or even the head. This can be a strong bearish signal.
characteristics: Developing inverse H&S structure (left shoulder, head, right shoulder).
Price fails to break up through the neckline significantly.
Instead price falls again, often below the level of the right shoulder or the head.
Signals that buyers were not strong enough to reverse the trend.
headAndShouldersBottomFailure.trading:
A sell signal emerges when price shows renewed weakness after the failed neckline break and falls below key support levels of the unfinished inverse H&S pattern.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position when price falls below the right shoulder or the head of the failed inverse H&S pattern. SL: above the neckline or the high of the right shoulder. TP: based on prior support levels or Fibonacci projections of the preceding downtrend.
headAndShouldersBottomFailure.advancedConsiderations: Watch the volume: a failed break with low volume on the neckline-break attempt, followed by a higher-volume decline, is a stronger signal.
headAndShouldersBottomFailure.performanceStats: Analogous to the H&S top failure, only in the opposite direction.

doubleTop.name: Double Top
doubleTop.description: A double top is a bearish reversal pattern that occurs after a significant uptrend. It consists of two roughly equal highs with a moderate low in between.
characteristics: Two consecutive highs at a similar level.
An intermediate low (support line) between the highs.
Volume is often higher on the first high than on the second.
doubleTop.trading:
A sell signal is generated when price falls below the support line (the intermediate low). The price target is often the height of the pattern (distance from the highs to the support line), projected downward.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high when the support break is confirmed by volume. Probability is higher when the second high does not exceed the first and bearish divergences appear in indicators.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position after the support-line break. SL: just above the support line (which is now resistance) or above the highs. TP: pattern height projected down from the breakout point.
doubleTop.advancedConsiderations:
Failed breakouts: A downside break below the support line that quickly closes back above it can be a trap. An upside breakout above the highs negates the pattern.
Variations: The highs do not need to match exactly; slight deviations are normal. The intermediate low can vary in depth.
Context: Stronger after a long uptrend. Bearish divergences (e.g. in RSI) between the two highs add conviction.
Combinations: Can be part of a larger distribution phase.
doubleTop.performanceStats: Considered a reliable reversal pattern. Win rate can be improved with confirmation signals such as volume or divergences.

doubleBottom.name: Double Bottom
doubleBottom.description: A double bottom is a bullish reversal pattern that occurs after a significant downtrend. It consists of two roughly equal lows with a moderate high in between.
characteristics: Two consecutive lows at a similar level.
An intermediate high (resistance line) between the lows.
Volume can be lighter on the second low and expand on the breakout.
doubleBottom.trading:
A buy signal is generated when price rises above the resistance line (the intermediate high). The price target is often the height of the pattern (distance from the lows to the resistance line), projected upward.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high when the resistance break is confirmed by volume. Probability is higher when the second low does not undercut the first and bullish divergences appear in indicators.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position after the resistance-line break. SL: just below the resistance line (which is now support) or below the lows. TP: pattern height projected up from the breakout point.
doubleBottom.advancedConsiderations:
Failed breakouts: An upside break above the resistance line that quickly closes back below it can be a trap. A break below the lows negates the pattern.
Variations: The lows do not need to match exactly. The intermediate high can vary in height.
Context: Stronger after a long downtrend. Bullish divergences (e.g. in RSI) between the two lows add conviction.
Combinations: Can be part of a larger accumulation phase.
doubleBottom.performanceStats: Considered a reliable reversal pattern. Analogous to the double top; confirmation signals matter.

tripleTop.name: Triple Top
tripleTop.description: A triple top is a bearish reversal pattern, similar to the double top but with three highs at roughly the same level. It signals a stronger resistance zone.
characteristics: Three consecutive highs at a similar level.
Two intermediate lows (support line) between the highs.
Volume often declines with each successive high.
tripleTop.trading:
A sell signal is generated when price falls below the support line (formed by the intermediate lows). The price target is often the height of the pattern.

Probability of a good trade: High, since it represents stronger confirmation of resistance than a double top. Volume confirmation on the break matters.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position after the support-line break. SL: just above the support line or above the highs. TP: pattern height projected down from the breakout point.
tripleTop.advancedConsiderations: Context: A triple top after a very strong uptrend carries more weight. Watch for divergences in indicators across the three highs.
tripleTop.performanceStats: Stronger than a double top since resistance was confirmed three times. Good win rate on a clean break.

tripleBottom.name: Triple Bottom
tripleBottom.description: A triple bottom is a bullish reversal pattern, similar to the double bottom but with three lows at roughly the same level. It signals a stronger support zone.
characteristics: Three consecutive lows at a similar level.
Two intermediate highs (resistance line) between the lows.
Volume can be lighter on the third low and expand on the breakout.
tripleBottom.trading:
A buy signal is generated when price rises above the resistance line (formed by the intermediate highs). The price target is often the height of the pattern.

Probability of a good trade: High, since it represents stronger confirmation of support than a double bottom. Volume confirmation on the break matters.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position after the resistance-line break. SL: just below the resistance line or below the lows. TP: pattern height projected up from the breakout point.
tripleBottom.advancedConsiderations: Context: A triple bottom after a very strong downtrend carries more weight. Watch for divergences in indicators across the three lows.
tripleBottom.performanceStats: Stronger than a double bottom. Good win rate on a clean break.

fallingWedge.name: Falling Wedge
fallingWedge.description: A falling wedge is typically a bullish reversal formation but can also appear as a continuation pattern in an uptrend. It is formed by two converging, downward-sloping lines.
characteristics: Two downward-sloping lines (resistance and support) that converge.
The upper line (resistance) falls more steeply than the lower line (support).
Volume often contracts during formation and expands sharply on the breakout.
fallingWedge.trading:
A buy signal emerges when price breaks out above the upper resistance line. The price target is often the widest part of the wedge, projected from the breakout point.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high, especially when the breakout happens on high volume and the wedge forms after a downtrend (reversal).
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position after the breakout above the upper wedge line. SL: below the breakout point or below the most recent low inside the wedge. TP: height of the wedge base, projected up from the breakout point.
fallingWedge.advancedConsiderations: Context and interpretation (duality): Can act as a reversal or a continuation pattern.
fallingWedge.performanceStats: Falling wedges have a relatively high success rate as bullish patterns, especially after a downtrend.

risingWedge.name: Rising Wedge
risingWedge.description: A rising wedge is typically a bearish reversal formation but can also appear as a continuation pattern in a downtrend. It is formed by two converging, upward-sloping lines.
characteristics: Two upward-sloping lines (resistance and support) that converge.
The lower line (support) rises more steeply than the upper line (resistance).
Volume often contracts during formation and expands on the breakout.
risingWedge.trading:
A sell signal emerges when price breaks down below the lower support line. The price target is often the widest part of the wedge, projected from the breakout point.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high, especially when the breakout happens on high volume and the wedge forms after an uptrend (reversal).
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position after the breakdown below the lower wedge line. SL: above the breakout point or above the most recent high inside the wedge. TP: height of the wedge base, projected down from the breakout point.
risingWedge.advancedConsiderations: Context and interpretation (duality): Can act as a reversal or a continuation pattern. Bearish divergences in oscillators raise the probability.
risingWedge.performanceStats: Rising wedges have a relatively high success rate as bearish patterns.

diamondTop.name: Diamond Top
diamondTop.description: A diamond top is a rare but reliable bearish reversal formation that occurs after an uptrend. It resembles a combination of a broadening top and a symmetrical triangle.
characteristics: Starts with diverging highs and lows (broadening phase).
Followed by converging highs and lows (triangle phase).
The four swing points form a diamond shape.
diamondTop.trading:
A sell signal emerges when price breaks down through the lower-right trendline of the diamond. The price target is often determined by measuring the largest vertical distance inside the diamond and projecting it down from the breakout point.

Probability of a good trade: Medium. Diamond formations are rarer and can be harder to identify.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position after the break of the lower-right trendline. SL: above the most recent high inside the diamond. TP: diamond height projected down from the breakout point.

diamondBottom.name: Diamond Bottom
diamondBottom.description: A diamond bottom is a rare but reliable bullish reversal formation that occurs after a downtrend. It is the mirror image of the diamond top.
characteristics: Starts with diverging lows and highs (broadening phase).
Followed by converging lows and highs (triangle phase).
The four swing points form a diamond shape.
diamondBottom.trading:
A buy signal emerges when price breaks up through the upper-right trendline of the diamond. The price target is often determined by measuring the largest vertical distance inside the diamond and projecting it up from the breakout point.

Probability of a good trade: Medium.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position after the break of the upper-right trendline. SL: below the most recent low inside the diamond. TP: diamond height projected up from the breakout point.

roundingTop.name: Rounding Top
roundingTop.description: A rounding top is a bearish reversal formation representing a gradual transition from an uptrend to a downtrend. It has an inverted U-shape.
characteristics: Volume often declines while the top forms and can expand on a support break (if present).
Signals fading buying power and growing willingness to sell.
roundingTop.trading:
A sell signal can emerge when price breaks a significant support line below the top, or once the downtrend is confirmed after the rounding.

Probability of a good trade: Medium. The pattern develops slowly. Confirmation of the downtrend is essential.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position after a support-line break. SL: above the highest point of the top. TP: can be projected from the height of the top.

roundingBottom.name: Rounding Bottom
roundingBottom.description: A rounding bottom (also saucer bottom) is a bullish reversal formation representing a gradual transition from a downtrend to an uptrend. It has a U-shape.
characteristics: Volume often declines while the bottom forms and rises as the uptrend begins.
Signals fading selling pressure and growing buying power.
roundingBottom.trading:
A buy signal can emerge when price breaks a significant resistance line above the bottom, or once the uptrend is confirmed after the rounding.

Probability of a good trade: Medium.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position after a resistance-line break. SL: below the lowest point of the bottom. TP: bottom height projected upward.

broadeningTop.name: Broadening Top
broadeningTop.description: A broadening top (also megaphone top) is a bearish reversal formation characterized by increasing volatility. It consists of three rising highs and two falling lows, with diverging trendlines.
characteristics: Two diverging trendlines: upper rising, lower falling.
At least three higher highs and two lower lows.
Signals growing uncertainty and volatility, often at the end of an uptrend.
broadeningTop.trading:
A sell signal can emerge when price falls below the lower trendline after the third high. Hard to trade due to high volatility.

Probability of a good trade: Medium.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position after the lower-trendline break. SL: above the third high. TP: formation height projected down from the breakout point.

broadeningBottom.name: Broadening Bottom
broadeningBottom.description: A broadening bottom (also megaphone bottom) is a bullish reversal formation characterized by increasing volatility. It consists of three falling lows and two rising highs.
characteristics: Two diverging trendlines: upper rising, lower falling.
At least three lower lows and two higher highs.
Signals growing uncertainty and volatility, often at the end of a downtrend.
broadeningBottom.trading:
A buy signal can emerge when price rises above the upper trendline after the third low.

Probability of a good trade: Medium.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position after the upper-trendline break. SL: below the third low. TP: formation height projected up from the breakout point.

islandReversal.name: Island Reversal
islandReversal.description: An island reversal is a strong reversal formation characterized by a price gap, a consolidation phase, and another gap in the opposite direction.
characteristics: A gap in the direction of the trend.
A gap in the opposite direction that isolates the island.
Signals a sharp and often emotional reversal.
islandReversal.trading:
A bearish island reversal (top) forms after an uptrend, a bullish island reversal (bottom) after a downtrend.

Probability of a good trade: High when both gaps are clearly defined.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: after the second gap in the new direction. SL: on the other side of the island. TP: often significant.

pipeBottom.name: Pipe Bottom
pipeBottom.description: A pipe bottom is a bullish reversal formation characterized by two long, parallel or slightly converging down candles with deep lows, followed by a strong upward move.
characteristics: Two long bearish candles (pipes) with similar or deeper lows.
Signals seller capitulation followed by strong buying interest.
pipeBottom.trading:
A buy signal emerges when price rises decisively after the two pipes.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long position once price forms a strong bullish candle after the pipes. SL: below the pipe lows.

pipeTop.name: Pipe Top
pipeTop.description: A pipe top is a bearish reversal formation, the mirror image of the pipe bottom. It is characterized by two long up candles with high highs.
characteristics: Two long bullish candles (pipes) with similar or higher highs.
pipeTop.trading:
A sell signal emerges when price falls decisively after the two pipes.

Probability of a good trade: Medium to high.
Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short position once the reversal is confirmed. SL: above the pipe highs.

bumpAndRunReversalTop.name: Bump and Run Reversal Top
bumpAndRunReversalTop.description: A bearish reversal formation. It starts with a moderate uptrend (lead-in), followed by a steep, excessive advance (bump) that breaks the original trendline.
characteristics: Run phase: after the bump fails, price falls below the lead-in trendline.
bumpAndRunReversalTop.trading:
Sell signal on the lead-in trendline break.

Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: short after the lead-in trendline break. SL: above the bump high.

bumpAndRunReversalBottom.name: Bump and Run Reversal Bottom
bumpAndRunReversalBottom.description: A bullish reversal formation. It starts with a moderate downtrend, followed by a steep decline (bump).
characteristics: Run phase: after the bump fails, price rises above the lead-in trendline.
bumpAndRunReversalBottom.trading:
Buy signal on the upside break of the lead-in trendline.

Trade entry with TP and SL: Entry: long after the lead-in trendline break. SL: below the bump low.

spikeTop.name: Spike Top
spikeTop.description: A spike top (V-top) is a sharp, fast reversal formation without significant consolidation.
spikeTop.trading: Hard to trade. Wait for confirmation. Often a sign of excess.

spikeBottom.name: Spike Bottom
spikeBottom.description: A spike bottom (V-bottom) is a sharp, fast bullish reversal formation.
spikeBottom.trading: Hard to trade. Wait for confirmation.

threeDrivesTop.name: Three Drives to a Top
threeDrivesTop.description: A bearish reversal formation with three symmetrical highs.
characteristics: Two corrective phases between the drives.
threeDrivesTop.trading: Sell signal once the third drive completes.

threeDrivesBottom.name: Three Drives to a Bottom
threeDrivesBottom.description: A bullish reversal formation with three symmetrical lows.
threeDrivesBottom.trading: Buy signal once the third drive completes.

hornTop.name: Horn Top
hornTop.description: A bearish reversal formation with two sharp highs (horns) and an intermediate low.
hornTop.trading: Sell signal on the break of the intermediate low.

hornBottom.name: Horn Bottom
hornBottom.description: A bullish reversal formation with two sharp lows (horns) and an intermediate high.
hornBottom.trading: Buy signal on the break of the intermediate high.

eveAdamTop.name: Eve & Adam Top
eveAdamTop.description: Bearish reversal: rounded high (Eve) followed by a sharp high (Adam).

eveAdamBottom.name: Eve & Adam Bottom
eveAdamBottom.description: Bullish reversal: rounded low (Eve) followed by a sharp low (Adam).

invertedCupAndHandleReversal.name: Inverted Cup and Handle (Reversal)
invertedCupAndHandleReversal.description: Bearish reversal formation, the mirror image of the cup and handle.
invertedCupAndHandleReversal.trading: Sell signal on the breakdown below handle support.

cupAndHandle.name: Cup and Handle
cupAndHandle.trading: Buy on the breakout above the handle.

bullishPennant.name: Bullish Pennant
bullishPennant.description: Short-term continuation after a strong advance.

bearishPennant.name: Bearish Pennant
bearishPennant.description: Short-term continuation after a strong decline.

ascendingChannel.name: Ascending Channel
ascendingChannel.trading: Trades inside the channel or on the breakout (caution).

descendingChannel.name: Descending Channel
descendingChannel.trading: Trades inside the channel or on the breakout.

deadCatBounce.name: Dead Cat Bounce
deadCatBounce.description: Short-lived recovery after a sharp sell-off, followed by further decline.
deadCatBounce.trading: No long entry signal. Warning sign.

runawayGap.name: Runaway Gap
runawayGap.description: Gap in the middle of a trend, signaling acceleration.
runawayGap.trading: Enter in the direction of the trend.

exhaustionGap.name: Exhaustion Gap
exhaustionGap.description: Gap at the end of a trend, signaling reversal.

doji.name: Doji
doji.description:
A Doji forms when the opening and closing prices are virtually the same. It represents a state of equilibrium between buyers and sellers.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ |\text{Open} - \text{Close}| \le 0.1 \times (\text{High} - \text{Low}) $$
doji.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Indecision. Warning of potential reversal if found at a trend extreme.
*   **Crypto Context:** In low-liquidity crypto pairs, Dojis can form frequently due to lack of trading. Ensure volume is significant.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the low (for bullish setup) or above the high (bearish).
doji.indicatorCombination: Bollinger Bands squeeze often accompanies Dojis before a breakout. RSI divergence adds weight to a reversal thesis.

spinning_top.name: Spinning Top
spinning_top.description:
Small body centered with long wicks on both sides.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body} < 0.3 \times \text{Range} $$
spinning_top.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Neutral / Indecision.
*   **Context:** If found in a trend, it signals tiring momentum.
*   **Strategy:** Place bracket orders above High and below Low to catch the breakout.
spinning_top.indicatorCombination: Bollinger Band width often decreases (squeeze) around Spinning Tops.

abandoned_baby_bullish.name: Abandoned Baby (Bullish)
abandoned_baby_bullish.description:
A very rare bullish reversal. 1. Long Bearish. 2. Doji gapping down (isolated). 3. Bullish gapping up.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{2} < \text{Low}_{1} \text{ and } \text{High}_{2} < \text{Low}_{3} $$
abandoned_baby_bullish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Trend is completely exhausted.
*   **Action:** Buy immediately on the gap up of the 3rd candle.
*   **Target:** The open of the first bearish candle.
abandoned_baby_bullish.indicatorCombination: Due to its rarity and strength, combining it with other indicators is less critical, but an oversold condition (RSI, Stochastics) before the pattern can reinforce the bullish implication.

belt_hold_bullish.name: Belt Hold (Bullish)
belt_hold_bullish.description:
A long bullish candle opening at its low (no lower wick) and closing near its high.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open} = \text{Low} $$

  $$ \text{Close} \approx \text{High} $$
belt_hold_bullish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** Aggressive buy on the close.
*   **Stop Loss:** Just below the low of the candle.
*   **Crypto:** Watch for this on 4H timeframes at support levels.
belt_hold_bullish.indicatorCombination: High buy volume is required to confirm it's not a 'bull trap'.

breakaway_bullish.name: Breakaway (Bullish)
breakaway_bullish.description:
A long bearish candle followed by a gap down and three small drifting candles, then a strong bullish candle closing the gap.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{5} > \text{Low}_{1} $$
breakaway_bullish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Oversold bounce turning into reversal.
*   **Entry:** On the 5th candle breakout.
*   **Target:** The top of the first bearish candle.
breakaway_bullish.indicatorCombination: RSI usually deeply oversold (<20) before the reversal candle.

bullish_engulfing.name: Bullish Engulfing
bullish_engulfing.description:
A strong reversal signal where a small bearish candle is followed by a larger bullish candle that completely eclipses the previous body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{curr} > \text{Body}_{prev} $$

  $$ \text{Close}_{curr} > \text{Open}_{prev} $$

  $$ \text{Open}_{curr} < \text{Close}_{prev} $$
bullish_engulfing.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** On the close of the engulfing candle or a pullback to the midpoint of its body.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the low of the engulfing candle.
*   **Target:** 1.5x to 2x risk distance.
bullish_engulfing.indicatorCombination: High volume on the engulfing candle is critical in crypto to avoid 'fakeouts'. Look for oversold RSI (<30) prior to the pattern.

bullish_harami.name: Bullish Harami
bullish_harami.description:
A large bearish candle followed by a small bullish candle contained within the first body. Also known as an 'Inside Bar'.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{2} < \text{High}_{1} \text{ and } \text{Low}_{2} > \text{Low}_{1} $$
bullish_harami.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Volatility contraction. Pending breakout.
*   **Strategy:** Trade the breakout of the 'Mother Bar' (first candle) High.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the Mother Bar Low.
bullish_harami.indicatorCombination: Watch for declining volume on the Harami (consolidation) and a spike on the breakout.

bullish_harami_cross.name: Bullish Harami Cross
bullish_harami_cross.description:
A Bullish Harami where the second candle is a Doji. Indicates higher uncertainty than a regular Harami.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{2} \approx 0 \text{ and Inside Candle } 1 $$
bullish_harami_cross.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** High probability reversal pending.
*   **Strategy:** Wait for the break of the mother bar high.
bullish_harami_cross.indicatorCombination: Similar to the Bullish Harami, but the Doji component often makes the signal stronger, especially when accompanied by volume on the confirmation candle.

bullish_kicker.name: Bullish Kicker
bullish_kicker.description:
A bearish candle followed immediately by a bullish candle that gaps up and runs. Very strong.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open}_{2} > \text{High}_{1} $$
bullish_kicker.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Violent sentiment shift, often news-driven.
*   **Action:** Market Buy. Do not wait for pullbacks (they may not come).
*   **Crypto Nuance:** Rare in continuous markets, but seen during major protocol announcements.
bullish_kicker.indicatorCombination: Volume should be massive on the Kicker candle.

concealing_baby_swallow.name: Concealing Baby Swallow
concealing_baby_swallow.description:
Four bearish candles. Two Marubozus, one Hammer, one Engulfing.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Complex Formation} $$
concealing_baby_swallow.interpretation:
### Rules
* Very Rare. Bottom reversal likely.
concealing_baby_swallow.indicatorCombination: Due to its rarity, specific indicator combinations are less documented. Confirmation through volume and subsequent bullish price action is crucial.

dragonfly_doji.name: Dragonfly Doji
dragonfly_doji.description:
A Doji where the Open and Close are at the High of the day. It has a long lower shadow and no upper shadow.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open} \approx \text{Close} \approx \text{High} $$
dragonfly_doji.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Strong rejection of lower prices (Bullish).
*   **Entry:** Buy on break of the high.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the long lower tail.
dragonfly_doji.indicatorCombination: Often marks the exact bottom of a flash crash or liquidity sweep in crypto.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.description:
A Hammer candle is a bullish reversal pattern in trading that appears at the end of a downtrend. Identification is based on specific geometric ratios between the body and the wick.

### Mathematical Criteria (Formulas)
To objectively define a candle as a Hammer, the following formulas are often used:

*   **Shadow-to-Body Ratio:** The lower shadow (wick) must be at least twice as long as the candle body.

  $$ \text{Lower Shadow} \ge 2 \times |\text{Open} - \text{Close}| $$
*   **Body Position (Fibonacci Method):** The entire candle body must be in the upper third (above the 38.2% Fibonacci retracement) of the candle's total trading range.
*   **Upper Shadow:** It should be very small or non-existent.

  $$ \text{Upper Shadow} \le 0.1 \times \text{Total Range} $$
hammer.interpretation:
### Trading Formulas for Entry and Exit
When a Hammer candle is identified, traders often use standardized formulas for setting order levels:

| Action | Formula / Rule |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Entry (Buy)** | High of the Hammer + small buffer (e.g., 1-2 pips/points). |
| **Stop-Loss (SL)** | Low of the Hammer - small buffer. |
| **Target** | Entry + (2 * (Entry - SL)) for a 2:1 Risk-Reward Ratio. |

### Important Context
*   **Trend:** A Hammer is only significant after a clear downtrend (at least 3-5 falling candles).
*   **Confirmation:** Many traders wait for the next candle; if it closes above the high of the Hammer, the signal is confirmed.
*   **Context:** The success rate increases significantly if the Hammer occurs at a known support zone or a moving average (e.g., 50 EMA).
hammer.indicatorCombination: A Hammer at a key support line or a moving average is a stronger signal. An increase in volume on the Hammer candle or the confirmation candle supports the reversal.

homing_pigeon.name: Homing Pigeon
homing_pigeon.description:
Bullish Reversal. Bearish candle followed by smaller bearish inside candle.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Inside Bar (Bear/Bear)} $$
homing_pigeon.indicatorCombination: A bullish divergence on an oscillator (e.g., RSI, MACD) can reinforce the Homing Pigeon signal. Look for a confirmation candle with higher volume.

inverted_hammer.name: Inverted Hammer
inverted_hammer.description:
A bullish reversal pattern appearing after a downtrend. Small body at the bottom, long upper wick.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Upper Shadow} \ge 2 \times \text{Body} $$

  $$ \text{Lower Shadow} < \text{Body} $$
inverted_hammer.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Buying pressure is testing higher levels.
*   **Confirmation:** Essential. Wait for the next candle to close higher.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the low of the Inverted Hammer.
inverted_hammer.indicatorCombination: Look for a volume spike on the Inverted Hammer compared to previous bearish candles.

ladder_bottom.name: Ladder Bottom
ladder_bottom.description:
Three black crows, then inverted hammer, then strong bullish candle.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ 3 \times \text{Bear} \to \text{Inv. Hammer} \to \text{Bull} $$
ladder_bottom.interpretation:
### Rules
* Buy the breakout of the last candle.
ladder_bottom.indicatorCombination: An increase in volume on the fifth (breakout) candle is a strong confirmation sign. It can also be supported by the breaking of a short-term downtrend line.

matching_low.name: Matching Low
matching_low.description:
Two bearish candles closing at same low.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{1} = \text{Close}_{2} $$
matching_low.interpretation:
### Rules
* Support confirmed. Buy with tight stop.
matching_low.indicatorCombination: Its appearance at a known support line or in an oversold zone (RSI) can increase the significance of the Matching Low. A confirmation candle with volume is important.

morning_doji_star.name: Morning Doji Star
morning_doji_star.description:
Like Morning Star but the middle candle is a Doji. More bearish implications for the star itself, leading to a stronger reversal if confirmed.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{2} \approx 0 $$
morning_doji_star.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Strong Bullish Reversal.
*   **Entry:** On the 3rd candle close.
morning_doji_star.indicatorCombination: Volume should be low on the Doji. A significant increase in volume on the third (bullish) candle is a strong confirmation feature. An oversold condition (RSI) before the pattern increases its significance.

morning_star.name: Morning Star
morning_star.description:
A three-candle bullish reversal pattern: 1. Long bearish candle. 2. Small gap-down candle (Star). 3. Strong bullish candle closing into the first body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} > \frac{\text{Open}_{1} + \text{Close}_{1}}{2} $$
morning_star.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** On the opening of the 4th candle.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the low of the 'Star' (middle candle).
*   **Context:** Stronger if the third candle has high volume.
morning_star.indicatorCombination: The 'Star' often coincides with an RSI dip below 30. A subsequent move above 30 confirms the reversal.

piercing_line.name: Piercing Line
piercing_line.description:
Two-candle bullish reversal. Bearish candle followed by a bullish candle that opens lower but closes above the midpoint of the first.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{2} > \frac{\text{Open}_{1} + \text{Close}_{1}}{2} $$
piercing_line.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Buyers are rejecting the lows and regaining territory.
*   **Crypto Context:** 'Gaps' are small in crypto; look for the strong close above the midpoint.
piercing_line.indicatorCombination: RSI crossing back above 30 from oversold territory confirms the move.

stick_sandwich.name: Stick Sandwich
stick_sandwich.description:
Two bearish candles with a bullish candle sandwiched in between. The two bearish candles close at the same price (Support).

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} = \text{Close}_{1} $$
stick_sandwich.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Bullish Reversal / Double Bottom.
*   **Entry:** Buy the support test at Close 3.
stick_sandwich.indicatorCombination: Its appearance at a key support line or a moving average increases its significance. Volume confirmation on the middle bullish candle or the subsequent confirmation candle is positive.

three_inside_up.name: Three Inside Up
three_inside_up.description:
Confirmed Bullish Harami. 1. Bearish. 2. Small Bullish (Inside). 3. Bullish closing above 2.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} > \text{High}_{2} $$
three_inside_up.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Confirmed Reversal.
*   **Entry:** On the close of the 3rd candle.
three_inside_up.indicatorCombination: Higher probability than a standalone Harami.

three_outside_up.name: Three Outside Up
three_outside_up.description:
Confirmed Bullish Engulfing. 1. Bearish. 2. Engulfing Bullish. 3. Bullish closing higher.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} > \text{High}_{2} $$
three_outside_up.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Strong Reversal.
*   **Entry:** Aggressive traders entered on candle 2; conservative enter on 3.

three_white_soldiers.name: Three White Soldiers
three_white_soldiers.description:
Three consecutive long bullish candles with higher closes. Each opens within the previous body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{i} > \text{Close}_{i-1} \quad \text{for } i=2,3 $$
three_white_soldiers.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Very strong trend continuation or reversal.
*   **Caution:** If candles are too large, market may be overextended (parabolic).
*   **Strategy:** Wait for a small pullback after the 3rd soldier to enter.
three_white_soldiers.indicatorCombination: ADX (Average Directional Index) should be rising, indicating strengthening trend.

tower_bottom.name: Tower Bottom
tower_bottom.description:
Long bearish candle, consolidation, then long bullish breakout.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Long Bear} \to \text{Base} \to \text{Long Bull} $$
tower_bottom.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Rounding Bottom.
*   **Entry:** On the breakout of the 'Tower' walls.
tower_bottom.indicatorCombination: Volume is often low during the consolidation phase. A significant increase in volume on the breakout bullish candles is a strong confirmation feature. A bullish divergence in the RSI during consolidation can reinforce the signal.

tri_star_bullish.name: Tri-Star (Bullish)
tri_star_bullish.description:
Three Dojis in a row with the middle one gapping down.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{1,2,3} \approx 0 $$
tri_star_bullish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Rare major bottom.
*   **Context:** Extreme indecision resolved by next bullish candle.
tri_star_bullish.indicatorCombination: Volume is typically low on all three Dojis. An increase on a bullish confirmation candle is crucial. An oversold condition before the pattern increases the probability of a reversal.

tweezer_bottoms.name: Tweezer Bottoms
tweezer_bottoms.description:
Two or more candles with matching lows. The bodies can be different sizes/colors.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Low}_{1} \approx \text{Low}_{2} $$
tweezer_bottoms.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Support level holds.
*   **Entry:** Buy with Stop Loss just below the Tweezer Lows.
*   **Crypto:** Very reliable on higher timeframes (Daily/Weekly).
tweezer_bottoms.indicatorCombination: Look for bullish divergence on RSI or MACD.

unique_three_river_bottom.name: Unique Three River Bottom
unique_three_river_bottom.description:
1. Long Bear. 2. Hammer (Bearish). 3. Small Bullish below 2.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Complex Sequence} $$
unique_three_river_bottom.interpretation:
### Rules
* Rare. Wait for close above candle 2 high.
unique_three_river_bottom.indicatorCombination: Due to its rarity, confirmation through increased volume on the third candle or a subsequent bullish candle is particularly important. Oversold oscillators can support the signal.

mat_hold.name: Mat Hold
mat_hold.description:
A strong bullish candle, a small gap up, and three small corrective candles staying above the first candle's low, followed by a new breakout.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Min}(\text{Lows}_{2,3,4}) > \text{Low}_{1} $$
mat_hold.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Bullish trend continuation (Flag pattern).
*   **Entry:** On the break of the highest high of the consolidation.
*   **Stop Loss:** Below the first candle's low.
mat_hold.indicatorCombination: Volume should drop during the small corrective candles.

rising_three_methods.name: Rising Three Methods
rising_three_methods.description:
Similar to Mat Hold but the corrective candles stay strictly within the first candle's range.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{2,3,4} < \text{High}_{1} \text{ and } \text{Low}_{2,3,4} > \text{Low}_{1} $$
rising_three_methods.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Trend Pause.
*   **Action:** Add to positions on the breakout of the first candle's high.

separating_lines_bullish.name: Separating Lines (Bullish)
separating_lines_bullish.description:
Bearish then Bullish. Open prices are equal.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open}_{1} = \text{Open}_{2} $$
separating_lines_bullish.interpretation:
### Rules
* Continuation. Trade with the trend.
separating_lines_bullish.indicatorCombination: An increase in volume on the second (bullish) candle can underscore the strength of the trend continuation. The pattern is stronger when it occurs above a key moving average.

side_by_side_white_lines_bullish.name: Side-by-Side White Lines (Bullish)
side_by_side_white_lines_bullish.description:
Bullish trend, Gap Up, two similar white candles side-by-side.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Gap Up} \to \text{Twin Bulls} $$
side_by_side_white_lines_bullish.indicatorCombination: Volume should at least remain stable or increase on the gaps and bullish candles to confirm strength. A MACD remaining in the bullish zone supports the signal.

upside_gap_three_methods.name: Upside Gap Three Methods
upside_gap_three_methods.description:
Bullish trend, gap up, fill gap, resume.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Gap Fill} $$
upside_gap_three_methods.interpretation:
### Rules
* Buy if gap holds as support.
upside_gap_three_methods.indicatorCombination: Volume should be high on the first two bullish candles (especially the gapping candle). Lower volume is desirable on the third (corrective bearish) candle. A renewed increase on the trend continuation is positive.

upside_tasuki_gap.name: Upside Tasuki Gap
upside_tasuki_gap.description:
Bullish Gap, then small bear candle stays in gap.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} > \text{Close}_{1} $$
upside_tasuki_gap.indicatorCombination: Volume should increase on the second candle (gap up). Lower volume on the third (bearish) candle is typical. A renewed volume increase on the trend continuation is positive.

bullish_marubozu.name: Bullish Marubozu
bullish_marubozu.description:
A long bullish candle with no shadows. Open is Low, Close is High.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open} = \text{Low} \text{ and } \text{Close} = \text{High} $$
bullish_marubozu.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Total buyer dominance.
*   **Strategy:** Buy the close. Use the midpoint of the body as support on pullbacks.
bullish_marubozu.indicatorCombination: Often starts a fresh trend leg. Check ADX for trend strength.

abandoned_baby_bearish.name: Abandoned Baby (Bearish)
abandoned_baby_bearish.description:
Rare bearish reversal. 1. Long Bullish. 2. Doji gapping up (isolated). 3. Bearish gapping down.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Low}_{2} > \text{High}_{1} \text{ and } \text{Low}_{2} > \text{High}_{3} $$
abandoned_baby_bearish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Major Top.
*   **Action:** Sell/Short immediately.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the Doji high.
abandoned_baby_bearish.indicatorCombination: An overbought condition (RSI, Stochastics) before the pattern can reinforce the bearish implication. Volume should be low on the Doji and increase significantly on the third, strong bearish candle.

advance_block.name: Advance Block
advance_block.description:
Three bullish candles with successively smaller bodies and longer upper wicks. A sign of weakening momentum.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{3} < \text{Body}_{2} < \text{Body}_{1} $$
advance_block.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Rally is stalling.
*   **Action:** Tighten stops on existing longs. Do not open new longs.
*   **Context:** Often seen at the end of parabolic crypto pumps.
advance_block.indicatorCombination: Bearish divergence on RSI is almost always present.

belt_hold_bearish.name: Belt Hold (Bearish)
belt_hold_bearish.description:
A long bearish candle opening at its high (no upper wick) and closing near its low.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open} = \text{High} $$

  $$ \text{Close} \approx \text{Low} $$
belt_hold_bearish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** Short on close.
*   **Stop Loss:** Just above the high.
*   **Signal:** Sellers controlled the entire session.
belt_hold_bearish.indicatorCombination: Often occurs when a resistance level is tested and rejected immediately.

breakaway_bearish.name: Breakaway (Bearish)
breakaway_bearish.description:
Bullish, Gap Up, Stalling, Bearish Break.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{5} < \text{High}_{1} $$
breakaway_bearish.indicatorCombination: An increase in volume on the fifth (breakout) candle is a strong confirmation sign. It can also be supported by the breaking of a short-term uptrend line.

bearish_engulfing.name: Bearish Engulfing
bearish_engulfing.description:
A bearish reversal pattern where a small bullish candle is followed by a larger bearish candle that consumes the previous body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{curr} > \text{Body}_{prev} $$

  $$ \text{Close}_{curr} < \text{Open}_{prev} $$

  $$ \text{Open}_{curr} > \text{Close}_{prev} $$
bearish_engulfing.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** Short on close of the second candle.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the high of the engulfing candle.
*   **Crypto Context:** Effective at all-time highs or resistance retests.
bearish_engulfing.indicatorCombination: Bearish divergence on MACD or RSI significantly increases success rate.

bearish_harami.name: Bearish Harami
bearish_harami.description:
A large bullish candle followed by a small bearish candle contained within the first body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{2} < \text{High}_{1} \text{ and } \text{Low}_{2} > \text{Low}_{1} $$
bearish_harami.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Momentum pause.
*   **Strategy:** Short the breakout of the Mother Bar Low.
*   **Target:** The start of the previous trend impulse.
bearish_harami.indicatorCombination: Often forms a 'Bear Flag' on lower timeframes.

bearish_harami_cross.name: Bearish Harami Cross
bearish_harami_cross.description:
A Bearish Harami where the second candle is a Doji.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{2} \approx 0 \text{ and Inside Candle } 1 $$
bearish_harami_cross.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Top formation.
*   **Strategy:** Short on break of mother bar low.
bearish_harami_cross.indicatorCombination: Similar to the Bearish Harami, but the Doji component often makes the signal stronger, especially when accompanied by volume on the confirmation candle.

bearish_kicker.name: Bearish Kicker
bearish_kicker.description:
A bullish candle followed immediately by a bearish candle that gaps down and crashes.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open}_{2} < \text{Low}_{1} $$
bearish_kicker.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Panic selling.
*   **Action:** Market Short or close Longs immediately.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the gap.
bearish_kicker.indicatorCombination: Usually accompanied by extreme volume spikes.

dark_cloud_cover.name: Dark Cloud Cover
dark_cloud_cover.description:
Two-candle bearish reversal. Bullish candle followed by a bearish candle that opens higher but closes below the midpoint of the first.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{2} < \frac{\text{Open}_{1} + \text{Close}_{1}}{2} $$
dark_cloud_cover.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Sellers are stepping in aggressively.
*   **Entry:** Short on the close or break of the low.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the high of the formation.
dark_cloud_cover.indicatorCombination: Bearish divergence on the Stochastic oscillator often accompanies this pattern.

deliberation_stalled.name: Deliberation / Stalled Pattern
deliberation_stalled.description:
Three white soldiers, but last one is small/star.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{3} \ll \text{Body}_{1,2} $$
deliberation_stalled.indicatorCombination: Decreasing volume over the three candles can signal waning buying power. A bearish divergence on oscillators (RSI, MACD) would reinforce the reversal signal.

evening_doji_star.name: Evening Doji Star
evening_doji_star.description:
Like Evening Star but the middle candle is a Doji.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{2} \approx 0 $$
evening_doji_star.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Strong Bearish Reversal.
*   **Entry:** Short on the 3rd candle close.
evening_doji_star.indicatorCombination: Volume should be low on the Doji. A significant increase in volume on the third (bearish) candle is a strong confirmation feature. An overbought condition (RSI) before the pattern increases its significance.

evening_star.name: Evening Star
evening_star.description:
A three-candle bearish reversal pattern: 1. Long bullish candle. 2. Small gap-up candle (Star). 3. Strong bearish candle closing deeply into the first body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} < \frac{\text{Open}_{1} + \text{Close}_{1}}{2} $$
evening_star.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** Short on the 4th candle open.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the high of the 'Star'.
*   **Crypto Nuance:** Gaps are rare in continuous crypto markets; the shape is more important than the gap itself.
evening_star.indicatorCombination: Look for decreasing volume on the first candle and increasing volume on the third (bearish) candle.

gravestone_doji.name: Gravestone Doji
gravestone_doji.description:
A Doji where the Open and Close are at the Low of the day. It has a long upper shadow and no lower shadow.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open} \approx \text{Close} \approx \text{Low} $$
gravestone_doji.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Rejection of higher prices (Bearish).
*   **Entry:** Short on break of the low.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the long upper wick.
gravestone_doji.indicatorCombination: Volume spike on the wick formation indicates 'smart money' selling into strength.

hanging_man.name: Hanging Man
hanging_man.description:
Bearish reversal pattern after an uptrend. Same shape as Hammer but at the top.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Lower Shadow} \ge 2 \times \text{Body} $$

  $$ \text{Upper Shadow} \le 0.1 \times \text{Range} $$
hanging_man.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Weakness. Buyers pushed price up but sellers forced it down during the session.
*   **Entry:** Short below the hanging man's low.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the high.
hanging_man.indicatorCombination: Often appears at resistance levels identified by Fibonacci extensions.

shooting_star.name: Shooting Star
shooting_star.description:
A bearish single-candle pattern with a small body at the bottom and a long upper wick. It signals rejection of higher prices.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Upper Shadow} \ge 2 \times \text{Body} $$

  $$ \text{Lower Shadow} \approx 0 $$
shooting_star.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Entry:** Short below the low of the Shooting Star.
*   **Stop Loss:** Above the high of the upper wick.
*   **Risk:** High volatility can trigger stops easily; use ATR buffer.
shooting_star.indicatorCombination: Ideally forms at the upper Bollinger Band. Overbought RSI (>70) is a standard confirmation.

three_black_crows.name: Three Black Crows
three_black_crows.description:
Three consecutive long bearish candles with lower closes. Each opens within the previous body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{i} < \text{Close}_{i-1} \quad \text{for } i=2,3 $$
three_black_crows.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Dominant selling pressure.
*   **Strategy:** Short on the close of the 3rd crow, or better, on a retest of the 2nd crow's low.
three_black_crows.indicatorCombination: Check for increasing volume on each crow. If volume decreases, the dump might be losing steam.

three_inside_down.name: Three Inside Down
three_inside_down.description:
Confirmed Bearish Harami. 1. Bullish. 2. Inside Bearish. 3. Bearish closing lower.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} < \text{Low}_{2} $$
three_inside_down.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Reversal confirmed.
*   **Entry:** Close of 3rd candle.
three_inside_down.indicatorCombination: An increase in volume on the third candle strengthens the signal. The pattern is more reliable when it occurs in an overbought zone (RSI) or at a resistance level.

three_outside_down.name: Three Outside Down
three_outside_down.description:
Confirmed Bearish Engulfing. 1. Bullish. 2. Engulfing Bearish. 3. Bearish closing lower.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} < \text{Low}_{2} $$
three_outside_down.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Strong Reversal.
*   **Entry:** Close of 3rd candle.
three_outside_down.indicatorCombination: Increasing volume on the second and third candles increases reliability. Its appearance after an overbought phase (RSI) or at a resistance line reinforces the signal.

tower_top.name: Tower Top
tower_top.description:
Long bullish candle, consolidation, then long bearish drop.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Long Bull} \to \text{Base} \to \text{Long Bear} $$
tower_top.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Rounding Top.
*   **Entry:** Breakdown of support.
tower_top.indicatorCombination: Volume is often low during the consolidation phase. A significant increase in volume on the breakout bearish candles is a strong confirmation feature. A bearish divergence in the RSI during consolidation can reinforce the signal.

tri_star_bearish.name: Tri-Star (Bearish)
tri_star_bearish.description:
Three Dojis in a row with the middle one gapping up.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Body}_{1,2,3} \approx 0 $$
tri_star_bearish.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Rare major top.
*   **Context:** Extreme indecision at highs.
tri_star_bearish.indicatorCombination: Volume is typically low on all three Dojis. An increase on a bearish confirmation candle is crucial. An overbought condition before the pattern increases the probability of a reversal.

tweezer_tops.name: Tweezer Tops
tweezer_tops.description:
Two or more candles with matching highs.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{1} \approx \text{High}_{2} $$
tweezer_tops.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Resistance holds (Double Top).
*   **Entry:** Short with Stop Loss just above the Tweezer Highs.
tweezer_tops.indicatorCombination: Often coincides with key Fibonacci retracement levels.

downside_gap_three_methods.name: Downside Gap Three Methods
downside_gap_three_methods.description:
Bearish trend, gap down, fill gap, resume.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Gap Fill} $$
downside_gap_three_methods.interpretation:
### Rules
* Short if gap holds as resistance.
downside_gap_three_methods.indicatorCombination: Volume should be high on the first two bearish candles (especially the gapping candle). Lower volume is desirable on the third (corrective bullish) candle.

downside_tasuki_gap.name: Downside Tasuki Gap
downside_tasuki_gap.description:
Bearish Gap, then small bull candle stays in gap.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{3} < \text{Close}_{1} $$
downside_tasuki_gap.indicatorCombination: Volume should increase on the second candle (gap down). Lower volume on the third (bullish) candle is typical.

falling_three_methods.name: Falling Three Methods
falling_three_methods.description:
A long bearish candle, followed by three small bullish candles within the first candle's range, then a new bearish drop.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{2,3,4} < \text{High}_{1} \text{ and } \text{Low}_{2,3,4} > \text{Low}_{1} $$
falling_three_methods.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Bearish continuation (Bear Flag).
*   **Entry:** Short on the break of the first candle's low.
falling_three_methods.indicatorCombination: Volume often dries up on the small pullback candles.

in_neck_line.name: In Neck Line
in_neck_line.description:
Bearish, then Bullish closing slightly into body.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{2} \approx \text{Low}_{1} $$
in_neck_line.interpretation:
### Rules
* Weak pullback. Trend likely continues down.
in_neck_line.indicatorCombination: No strong volume indication, but an increase on the continuation of the downtrend would be confirming. The pattern is stronger when it occurs below a key moving average.

on_neck_line.name: On Neck Line
on_neck_line.description:
Bearish, then Bullish closing at low.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{2} = \text{Low}_{1} $$
on_neck_line.indicatorCombination: Similar to In Neck Line. A MACD remaining in the bearish zone or showing a bearish crossover can support the signal.

separating_lines_bearish.name: Separating Lines (Bearish)
separating_lines_bearish.description:
Bullish then Bearish. Open prices are equal.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open}_{1} = \text{Open}_{2} $$
separating_lines_bearish.interpretation:
### Rules
* Continuation. Trade with the trend.
separating_lines_bearish.indicatorCombination: An increase in volume on the second (bearish) candle can underscore the strength of the trend continuation. The pattern is stronger when it occurs below a key moving average.

thrusting_line.name: Thrusting Line
thrusting_line.description:
Bearish, then Bullish closing below midpoint.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Close}_{2} < \text{Midpoint}_{1} $$
thrusting_line.indicatorCombination: No strong specific volume indication. The pattern is weaker than a Piercing Line and should be treated with caution; confirmation by further bearish candles is important.

two_black_gapping_candles.name: Two Black Gapping Candles
two_black_gapping_candles.description:
Bearish trend, two candles gapping down sequentially.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Gap}_{1} \text{ and } \text{Gap}_{2} $$
two_black_gapping_candles.indicatorCombination: Volume may increase on the gapping candles, confirming the bearish momentum. A break of key support levels after the pattern reinforces the signal.

bearish_marubozu.name: Bearish Marubozu
bearish_marubozu.description:
A long bearish candle with no shadows. Open is High, Close is Low.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Open} = \text{High} \text{ and } \text{Close} = \text{Low} $$
bearish_marubozu.interpretation:
### Trading Rules
*   **Signal:** Total seller dominance.
*   **Strategy:** Sell/Short. Do not try to catch the knife until a reversal pattern forms.
bearish_marubozu.indicatorCombination: If volume is low, it might be a liquidity trap. High volume confirms validity.

retracing_wicks.name: Retracing Wicks
retracing_wicks.description:
Multiple candles with long upper wicks at resistance.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{High}_{1} \approx \text{High}_{2} \text{ w/ Wicks} $$
retracing_wicks.indicatorCombination: The signal is stronger if the wick candles occur on high volume. A bearish divergence on oscillators (RSI, MACD) increases the significance.

advancing_wicks.name: Advancing Wicks
advancing_wicks.description:
Multiple candles with long lower wicks at support.

### Mathematical Criteria

  $$ \text{Low}_{1} \approx \text{Low}_{2} \text{ w/ Wicks} $$
advancing_wicks.indicatorCombination: The signal is reinforced by high volume on the wick candles and the bullish confirmation candle. A bullish divergence in the RSI or MACD makes a successful reversal more likely.
